headline: Second empty day; scores hold almost still
body: Another quiet weekend day with no scored events. The slow fade of older news continued, moving each line by a few hundredths at most. Nothing changes the picture left by the week's agent launches and chip results. Horizon Balance: +1.77.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Protector God -0.05 and Enslaved God -0.05.
